summary: Renames the order detail view from order_detail to show_order. The view now loads only the number and total_cents fields.

findings.title: Renamed view breaks URL configuration
findings.problem: The change renames order_detail to show_order. The detail route in orders/urls.py line 8 still references views.order_detail.
findings.consequence: Django raises AttributeError when it imports orders/urls.py. The whole URL configuration fails to load, so every page returns an error.
findings.fix: Update orders/urls.py to reference views.show_order. Alternatively, keep the original name order_detail.
